findings.finding: Card title uses <h2> instead of <h1> as specified in dpai login__title. Heading hierarchy within the card is semantically incorrect but causes no build failure and no visual difference.
Hardware keyboard (physical numpad) does not fill the PIN field because the dpai visually-hidden <input type='password'> that captures keyboard events is omitted. On-screen keypad still works.
Network banner text omits 'Transaksi tercatat langsung.' suffix present in dpai design.
'Simpan penerimaan' button rendered as sibling to <aside> rather than inside it. Visual position is acceptable but may break column placement in narrow layouts.
Tab filter buttons lack aria-controls pointing to a tabpanel wrapper. Keyboard navigation between tabs and panel content does not follow ARIA tab pattern.
Period filter (Hari ini / 7 hari / 30 hari) is placed inside the chart panel body rather than in the panel header area as in the dpai design. Both controls remain functional.
